basics.ugc: Deemed university under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.other: Medical (MBBS), dental, nursing, physiotherapy, pharmacy, engineering, law, management and hotel management. Approved by AICTE, Bar Council of India, Pharmacy Council of India and Indian Nursing Council

admission: Class 12 with English, Physics and Maths; MM(DU) cut-off 60%
Merit on CUET or JEE Main scores or Class 12 marks, then counselling
BBA, BCA, B.Pharm, BPT, B.Sc Nursing, integrated law
Class 12 with 40–50% depending on programme and category

scholarships.text: Merit-based scholarships as per MM(DU) policy, continued on attendance, results and conduct.

hostel.text: Hostel places for more than 7,000 students on campus. For MBBS (2025-26), a twin-sharing AC hostel with mess cost ₹2,50,000 a year.

fees.text: The application fee for the 2026 intake is ₹1,200. Course fees are listed programme-wise; ask us for the current fee for your course.
